old=p.read_text()
new='''def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_dividers = [r for r in range(1, height - 1)
                    if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_dividers = [c for c in range(1, width - 1)
                    if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(height)}) == 1]

    def segments(size, dividers):
        bounds = [-1, *dividers, size]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1])
                for i in range(len(bounds) - 1)]

    row_segments = segments(height, row_dividers)
    col_segments = segments(width, col_dividers)
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_segments:
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in col_segments:
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            background = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)
            marks = sum(value != background for value in cells)
            row.append(1 if marks == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
